first-run-promises--light--1120x900.rationale: Only the two bottom corners of the setup dialog differ, each pixel by one colour level, where the rounded corners show the blurred backdrop. Layout is identical to 1/1000 px on both sides; the page behind was removed and the nesting matched, and the light theme alone still differs. A compositing artifact of the 704 px tall dialog, not visible. Experiment recorded in docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-07.

tray-view-fr--light--372x676.rationale: One glyph differs in anti-aliasing only (an 8 x 8 px box, in “dans” / “libres”); the markup and text of both sides are identical (compared with outerHTML), and the count is the same on every run and in both themes. French text only; the same screens in English, German, Dutch and Spanish match exactly. Recorded in docs/decisions.md, 2026-11-07.
